name: nist-800-53
title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls and baselines
summary: Count, compare and cross-check NIST's security and privacy controls in its own machine-readable release: families, withdrawn controls, the LOW, MODERATE, HIGH and privacy baselines, tailoring, parameters and assessment procedures.
description: Each task gives the AI tables of NIST's control catalog, its four baselines and its assessment procedures, every value as NIST publishes it. The question states its facts, such as a system's impact level, and defines the words it uses. The AI gives exact answers: how many controls and enhancements a family has, where a withdrawn control went, what one baseline adds over another, a tailored system's control set, or whether two tables agree. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Catalog structure
families.what: Base controls and enhancements in each family, active and withdrawn, and their implementation levels.

families.name: Withdrawn controls
families.what: Which controls were withdrawn, whether they were moved or incorporated, and where they went.

families.name: Control links
families.what: Related and required links between controls, read in the right direction, one-way and mutual.

families.name: Baseline comparison
families.what: How big each baseline is, what one adds over another, the privacy baseline, and controls that no baseline includes.

families.name: Baseline consistency
families.what: Enhancements a baseline includes without their base control, and how much of related controls a baseline covers.

families.name: Tailoring
families.what: A system's control set after the tailoring steps the question gives, applied in order.

families.name: Parameters
families.what: Organization-defined parameters by control and family, their selection choices, and parameters that group others.

families.name: Control statements
families.what: The items of the control statements, how they nest, and the parameter placeholders they hold.

families.name: Assessment procedures
families.what: Assessment methods and objectives, and the parts of a statement each objective assesses.

families.name: Data check
families.what: Whether identifiers, parameters and links agree with the controls table, without false alarms.
